# Script 2: Calculate total line count of .txt files containing the keyword
cat << 'EOF' > /root/count_keyword_lines.sh
#!/bin/bash
# Script to calculate the total line count of all .txt files in the experiment directory
# (including subdirectories) where the lines contain at least one occurrence of the specified keyword.

EXPERIMENT_DIR="$HOME/experiment"
KEYWORD="${1:-keyword}"

if [ -z "$1" ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <keyword>"
    echo "Default keyword: keyword"
fi

if [ ! -d "$EXPERIMENT_DIR" ]; then
    echo "Error: Directory '$EXPERIMENT_DIR' does not exist."
    exit 1
fi

total_lines=0

# Find all .txt files recursively and count lines containing the keyword
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    # Count lines containing the keyword (case-sensitive)
    count=$(grep -c "$KEYWORD" "$file" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$count" ] && [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
        total_lines=$((total_lines + count))
        echo "File: $file -> $count lines with keyword '$KEYWORD'"
    fi
done < <(find "$EXPERIMENT_DIR" -type f -name "*.txt" -print0 | sort -z)

echo ""
echo "Total line count (lines containing keyword '$KEYWORD'): $total_lines"
EOF
chmod +x /root/count_keyword_lines.sh
echo "Script created successfully."
